cat > /tmp/f.py <<'PY'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, shutil
path = '/conf/config.xml'
shutil.copy(path, path + '.bak')
tree = ET.parse(path)
root = tree.getroot()
filt = root.find('filter')

rule = ET.Element('rule')
ET.SubElement(rule, 'type').text = 'block'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'ipprotocol').text = 'inet'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'protocol').text = 'tcp'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'descr').text = 'antrieb: refuse and log node3->node4 telnet'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'interface').text = 'lan'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'log').text = '1'
src = ET.SubElement(rule, 'source')
srcaddr = ET.SubElement(src, 'address')
srcaddr.text = '10.100.1.12'
dst = ET.SubElement(rule, 'destination')
dstaddr = ET.SubElement(dst, 'address')
dstaddr.text = '10.100.1.13'
dstport = ET.SubElement(dst, 'port')
dstport.text = '23'

# insert before the first existing rule in filter (so it's evaluated first / wins as first-match)
first_rule = filt.find('rule')
idx = list(filt).index(first_rule)
filt.insert(idx, rule)

tree.write(path, xml_declaration=True, encoding='utf-8')
print('rule inserted')
PY
python3 /tmp/f.py
